# Ladies and Sister Stalkers - GAMMA Rebase

The Ladies and Sister Stalkers (LASS 2.1) female player character for the
S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Anomaly modpack G.A.M.M.A., as the Female pack for
[GAMMA Character Selector](https://github.com/Q4ln/GAMMA-Character-Selector).
Choose Female on the New Game screen to play with the LASS female bodies,
first-person hands, voices, movement and headgear sounds, health-HUD
silhouette, video portraits and female-addressed dialogue. Male characters
stay as in GAMMA, and so do NPCs and mutants apart from their step sounds and
31 NPC suit textures.

It requires GAMMA Character Selector; without the Selector it does nothing.

## Download

Download the `.7z` from
[Releases](https://github.com/Q4ln/LASS-GAMMA-Rebase/releases/latest), not
"Source code", which holds only the README and the licence. Install it with
Mod Organizer 2. Its MO2 priority matters: see Installation in the README.

## Documentation

Requirements, installation, compatibility, saves, known issues, the changelog
and the full credits are in
[Ladies and Sister Stalkers - GAMMA Rebase - README.md](https://github.com/Q4ln/LASS-GAMMA-Rebase/blob/main/Ladies%20and%20Sister%20Stalkers%20-%20GAMMA%20Rebase%20-%20README.md),
which also ships inside the archive.

This repository holds only the README and the licence. The mod's files (about
3.6 GB of models, textures, sounds and videos, a 1.5 GB download) are in the
release archive.
